brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to determine if NM504 will prevent GI side effects that are associated with using metformin for the treatment of diabetes.
brief_title: Pilot Study of the Effect of MN-504 Cobiotic Formulation on the Efficacy and Tolerability of Metformin

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or a female with type 2 diabetes
* Known tolerance to metformin
* 18 years of age or older
* Body mass index that is not less than 20 kg/m2

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not pregnant or breast feeding a baby.
* Not taking chronic medication that has not had a stable dose for 1 month or longer.

official_title: A Pilot Study of the Effect of NM-504 Cobiotic Formulation on the Efficacy and Tolerability of Metformin in Patients With Metformin Intolerance
